Also called performer, cast member, player. Examples: "A movie's actor is 'Tom Hanks'.", "A play's actor is 'The Ensemble Theatre'.", "An episode's actor is 'Jane Doe'." Distinct from actors, which is a deprecated property for the same concept.

candidates.label: mainEntity
candidates.comment: A main entity relation between a creative work and the primary entity it describes. Also called: primary subject, about entity, central topic. Examples: "Wikipedia Article mainEntity Albert Einstein", "News Report mainEntity The Election", "Research Paper mainEntity Quantum Physics". Distinct from mainEntityOfPage, which indicates the page for which this thing is the main entity.

candidates.label: actors
candidates.comment: An actor relation between a creative work (e.g., movie, episode, video game) and a person who performs in it. Also called performer, cast member, player. Examples: "A movie's actors include 'Brad Pitt'.", "An episode's actors include 'Jennifer Aniston'." Distinct from actor, which is the preferred and more general property that also allows PerformingGroup.

candidates.label: mainContentOfPage
candidates.comment: A main content relation between a web page and the web page element that constitutes its primary subject. Also called: primary content, central element, core content. Examples: "Article Page mainContentOfPage ArticleBody", "Product Page mainContentOfPage ProductDescription", "Blog Post mainContentOfPage PostContent".

candidates.label: claimInterpreter
candidates.comment: An interpretation relation between a claim and the organization or person who interpreted it from media content. Also called "interpreted by", "claim analyst", "fact-checker". Examples: "News claim claimInterpreter FactCheck.org", "Social media claim claimInterpreter Jane Doe".

candidates.label: interpretedAsClaim
candidates.comment: A claim extraction relation between a creative work or media object and a specific assertion or statement derived from its content. Also called contains claim, implies claim, claim extracted from, claim derived from. Examples: A news article is interpretedAsClaim 'The sky is blue'. A scientific paper is interpretedAsClaim 'Drug X cures Y'. A video is interpretedAsClaim 'Candidate Z made promise A'.

candidates.label: mainEntityOfPage
candidates.comment: A main entity of page relation between a thing and the creative work or URL for which it is the primary described entity. Also called: primary page, described on page, featured on page. Examples: "Albert Einstein mainEntityOfPage Wikipedia Article", "The Election mainEntityOfPage News Report", "Quantum Physics mainEntityOfPage Research Paper". Distinct from mainEntity, which indicates the primary entity described in a creative work.

candidates.label: associatedClaimReview
candidates.comment: A claim review related to another review by common content, topic, or claim. Also called: related claim review, linked claim assessment. Examples: "Review 'MediaReview of Article' associatedClaimReview 'ClaimReview of Statement'", "Review 'FactCheck' associatedClaimReview 'Another FactCheck'". Distinct from associatedMediaReview, which links to a media review.

candidates.label: collection

candidates.label: target

candidates.label: additionalType

candidates.label: additionalNumberOfGuests

candidates.label: additionalProperty

candidates.label: bccRecipient

candidates.label: owns

candidates.label: ccRecipient

candidates.label: opponent

candidates.label: containedInPlace

candidates.label: containedIn
candidates.comment: A spatial containment relation between a place and the larger place that contains it. Also called "located in", "part of", "within".
